# Breaking changes to the planner's or the webapp's API made on purpose,
# which ci.yml's api-compat job lets through (oasdiff --err-ignore).
# One line each, dated, with the method and path and oasdiff's own words
# for the change, as its failure printed them, and why no released app
# is hurt. Kept after the merge, as the record of what was broken when.
# See docs/CI.md, "API compatibility".
2026-11-07 GET /api/status removed the required property `services/crewai_agent` from the response with the `200` status -- the agent services were removed (#495); only the Dev panel reads /api/status
2026-11-07 GET /api/status removed the required property `services/nav_log_agent` from the response with the `200` status -- the agent services were removed (#495); only the Dev panel reads /api/status
2026-11-07 POST /api/comparison api path removed without deprecation -- the LangGraph/CrewAI comparison was a web Dev screen; no phone calls it (#495)
